Q1: How should this issue be pointed at `ai/issue-6782`, given that a `/answer` comment cannot change what the resolver reads (it fetches only the issue body via `get_issue_body`)?
Choices:
A) Edit this issue's body to add the line `- Integration branch: `ai/issue-6782`` on its own line, then `/reclarify`. Planning and implementation will then check out `ai/issue-6782` and edit the test there. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Close this issue and open a new one whose body has the standalone `- Integration branch: `ai/issue-6782`` line, with the same specification and links to PR #6786 and #6801.
C) Close this issue and make the test change on PR #6786 directly, through review autofix or a commit to `ai/issue-6782`, without a separate issue.
D) Proceed unchanged. Planning will resolve to `main`, where the target test does not exist, and implementation will stop again. **Note:** this reproduces the #6801 block.
Q2: If PR #6786 is no longer open, or `ai/issue-6782` no longer exists when the implementer checks, what should happen?
Choices:
A) Stop with `BLOCKED: PR #6786 not open or branch ai/issue-6782 missing` and do not edit anything on `main`. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Close this issue as obsolete: the test only exists on that branch, so there is nothing to change.
Assumptions: the target test lives only on `ai/issue-6782`. I could not see PR #6786's live state from this checkout; the implementer must check it before editing, as the issue requires.
